name: tiki-mcp
description: Tiki (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool m

platform_mcp_tiki_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_tiki_client_id.description: App id of an IN-HOUSE application registered on the Tiki Open Platform and connected to your seller store (in-house apps receive the seller's permissions via the client-credentials flow).

platform_mcp_tiki_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_tiki_client_secret.description: App secret of the same application; sent with the id as HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) to https://api.tiki.vn/sc/oauth2/token. Apps configured for client_secret_post are not supported by this adapter.

platform_mcp_tiki_warehouse_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_WAREHOUSE_ID
platform_mcp_tiki_warehouse_id.description: Seller warehouse id (GET /integration/v2/sellers/me/warehouses) whose available quantity set_inventory writes.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Get seller: {id, name, active, operation_models, can_update_product, registration_status, live_at}.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /integration/v2/products/updateSku {product_id, price}: changes the LIVE price (VND) of one product, approved automatically; `listing_id` is the Tiki product_id. Stock is set_inventory; titles/descriptions go through product update requests (review), not here.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: updateSku with warehouse_quantities [{warehouse_id, qty_available}] for the configured warehouse; identify the product by `sku` (original_sku) or `listing_id` (product_id, used first when given). Sellers with several warehouses should note Tiki's warning that warehouses missing from the array are set to 0 on the batch endpoint.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Batch update PUT /integration/v2.1/products/updateSkus {data: [{product_id, status: 2}]} disables the product (status enum 1 enabled, 2 disabled, 3 hidden; reversible with 1).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Order Listing V2 ?page&limit&status (a set expression such as in|queueing,successful_delivery or nin|processing,waiting_payment)&created_from_date ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', UTC+07:00). Tiki recommends excluding processing/waiting_payment (not yet accepted). total is invoice.grand_total in VND; items and shipping in raw.
